remarks: This spacious side-by-side two-family home provides the benefits of living in a single family home without the responsibilities of home ownership! All the charm of a 1929 colonial - refinished hardwood floors, fireplace and a dining room with built-ins. Renovated kitchen with newer appliances. Three bedrooms on the second floor. Renovated bathroom. Great storage in the walk-up attic, laundry in basement, 1-car garage, newer natural gas boiler. Private backyard shared with next door neighbor. Landlord handles landscaping and snow removal. Don't miss this one!
